characters.continuity: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone (Book/Film)
characters.summary: Madam Rolanda Hooch is the flying instructor, Quiditch referee, and broom expert at Hogwarts. She relies on her broomstick for flight and refereeing duties.

sources.supports: Role as Flying instructor and Quidditch referee at Hogwarts.

campaignTags.claim: Flies using a broomstick as a standard mode of transport

unknowns: Exact combat capabilities outside of flying instruction and refereeing are not documented.

characters.summary: Madam Poppy Pomfrey is the head nurse at Hogwarts Hospital Wing, highly skilled in magical healing, potions, and restoration spells.
limitations: Specializes in medicine rather than offensive combat

sources.supports: Role as matron of Hogwarts Hospital Wing and proficiency in magical medicine.

campaignTags.claim: Expert magical healer capable of curing severe magical and physical ailments
Wand-wielding witch performing advanced medical and restorative charms

unknowns: Extent of offensive spellcasting repertoire is limited in documentation.

characters.continuity: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
characters.summary: Olympe Maxime is the half-giant Headmistress of Beauxbatons Academy of Magic. She possesses immense physical strength and advanced magical ability.

mechanisms: Giant physiology providing high physical durability

sources.supports: Half-giant heritage, magic use, and role as Beauxbatons headmistress.

campaignTags.claim: Is a half-giant standing nearly eleven feet tall
Wand-wielding witch and head of a magic academy

unknowns: Full extent of duelling feats outside of academic duties.

characters.summary: Minerva McGonagall is the Deputy Headmistress of Hogwarts, a master Transfigurationist, and a formidable duellist wielding powerful offensive and defensive magic.
limitations: Requires a wand for most magical operations

sources.supports: Transfiguration mastery, duelling prowess, and Deputy Headmistress role.

feats.claim: Animated suits of armour and statues to defend Hogwarts during the battle
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
notableResults.note: Fought Snape in Hogwarts castle, causing him to flee.

campaignTags.claim: Skilled witch capable of complex incantations and high-level transfiguration

unknowns: Full limits of her stamina in extended warfare.

characters.summary: In her feline Animagus form, Minerva McGonagall takes the shape of a tabby cat with distinctive markings around her eyes, retaining her human intellect while gaining stealth and agility.
weaknesses: Inability to cast spells or hold objects while in animal form
characters.formDifferences: Replaces wand-based spellcasting and humanoid stature with a small tabby cat form possessing enhanced agility and stealth but no direct spell output.

sources.supports: Details of her tabby cat Animagus form.

unknowns: Physical durability limits of the cat form compared to human form.

characters.summary: Moaning Myrtle is a Hogwarts ghost who haunts a girls' bathroom. As a spirit, she is physically intangible but can cause distress and manipulate water to a minor degree.

mechanisms: Incorporeal ghost physiology making her immune to standard physical attacks

weaknesses: Cannot physically interact with the living world beyond minor splashing or haunting
mobility: Incorporeal flight and gliding through solid matter
limitations: Bound to the plumbing and location of her death

sources.supports: Ghostly nature, hauntings, and bathroom residency.

campaignTags.claim: Capable of flooding bathrooms and manipulating plumbing water as a ghost

unknowns: Offensive combat capabilities against armed opponents.

characters.summary: Molly Weasley is a matriarch of the Weasley family and a capable witch. Though primarily a homemaker, she possesses formidable protective and offensive spellcasting ability under stress.

sources.supports: Wand magic capability and combat feats in the Battle of Hogwarts.

feats.claim: Killed Bellatrix Lestrange in single combat during the Battle of Hogwarts
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
notableResults.note: Killed Bellatrix after Bellatrix threatened Ginny Weasley.

campaignTags.claim: Wand-wielding witch capable of lethal combat duelling

unknowns: Frequency of active combat engagements prior to the Second Wizarding War.

characters.summary: Nagini is Lord Voldemort's giant pet snake and Horcrux. She possesses venomous bites, high durability, and a psychological link to her master.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to destruction by Gryffindor's Sword and Basilisk venom due to Horcrux status

sources.supports: Venomous snake nature, role as Horcrux, and attacks on characters.

feats.claim: Attacked Arthur Weasley at the Department of Mysteries, inflicting severe venom wounds
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

unknowns: Full extent of magical resilience before transformation into a Horcrux.

characters.summary: As a human Maledictus, Nagini carries a blood curse that eventually forces her permanent transformation into a snake. In her human form, she is capable of speech and human physical actions.
weaknesses: Blood curse leading to inevitable permanent beast transformation
characters.formDifferences: Replaces serpentine reptilian form and venom bite with a human female body capable of speech, reasoning, and human dexterity, subject to the Maledictus curse.

sources.supports: Maledictus curse details and human background prior to permanent transformation.

unknowns: Combat spellcasting proficiency while in human form.

characters.summary: Narcissa Malfoy is a pure-blood witch of the House of Black and mother to Draco Malfoy. She relies on traditional pure-blood social influence and wand magic, though she acts primarily out of maternal self-preservation.
limitations: Prefers political and social maneuvering over direct frontline combat

sources.supports: Pure-blood status, wand use, and Unbreakable Vow casting.

campaignTags.claim: Wand-wielding witch capable of complex magical contracts like the Unbreakable Vow
